title_en: Diffusion Schrödinger Bridge with Applications to Score-Based Generative Modeling
title_zh: 扩散Schrödinger桥及其在基于得分的生成建模中的应用

verified_metadata.title: Diffusion Schrödinger Bridge with Applications to Score-Based Generative Modeling
verified_metadata.journal: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems
verified_metadata.abstract: Diffusion Schrödinger Bridge alternates learned forward and backward Markov kernels as a continuous-state IPF approximation, correcting finite-time endpoint mismatch in score-based diffusion.
verified_metadata.comment: Proceedings PDF verified; corresponding preprint is arXiv:2106.01357

sections.title: 作者信息
paragraphs: 作者 Valentin De Bortoli、James Thornton、Jeremy Heng、Arnaud Doucet；NeurIPS 2021。核验会议正式PDF全文15页；对应 arXiv:2106.01357。会议PDF未列DOI，本卡不推测。

sections.title: 研究问题
paragraphs: score-based generative modeling需让forward noising SDE在终点足够接近Gaussian prior；短T或少steps会留下endpoint mismatch。能否把生成建模写成path-space entropy-regularized optimal transport，即Schrödinger bridge，并用多次forward/backward修正使有限时间两端精确匹配？

sections.title: 背景
paragraphs: Schrödinger bridge在reference diffusion path measure附近寻找满足data和prior marginals的最小KL process。Iterative Proportional Fitting交替投影两个endpoint constraints，类似discrete Sinkhorn；reverse-time drifts可由score/conditional regression估计。
第一轮DSB等价于传统SGM的reverse fit；后续轮次也更新forward drift，从而补偿pN≠pprior。‘finite time exact’属于理想IPF/continuous model极限，neural approximation、finite particles和Euler discretization仍产生误差。

sections.title: 模型与方法
paragraphs: 作者先离散reference diffusion为N-step Markov chain，交替用regression拟合backward kernels Bkn和forward kernels Fkn，构成Diffusion SB。理论分析IPF KL convergence、time-discretization和early SGM error，并给OU-like reference下的bounds。
实验用2D toy distributions验证marginals，MNIST/CelebA用reduced U-Net，扫描N=12–50与DSB iterations；另做Swiss-roll到S-curve、EMNIST到MNIST的arbitrary endpoint interpolation。

sections.title: 核心结果与证据
paragraphs: Figure 1在T=0.2、N=20时显示初始forward diffusion未到Gaussian且第一轮reverse未回data；第五轮DSB后两个endpoint明显匹配，直观展示迭代修正。
Figures 2–3定量/可视验证toy ground-truth mean、variance、covariance和四种2D shapes随20轮逼近。Figures 5–6显示CelebA在N=12等少steps时图像与FID随DSB iterations改善；作者明确说实现尚不与SOTA竞争。
Figure 7展示non-Gaussian endpoint间bridge，支持DSB不仅是data-to-Gaussian generator，也可视为continuous-state Sinkhorn工具。T过小时score在prior support附近难学，论文在discussion中承认质量下降。

sections.title: 有效性与局限
paragraphs: 每个DSB iteration需重新训练forward/backward regressors，少sampling steps不等于总训练更便宜；errors会在IPF iterations中传播。理论常数依赖regularity、finite entropy与kernel assumptions，未覆盖任意neural score class。
image实验低分辨率且缺少强SOTA baselines、多seed error bars和完整compute accounting。FID改善来自该配置，不能推出所有short-schedule diffusion都应增加IPF rounds；T、N、model capacity需联合调节。

sections.title: 复现与资源
paragraphs: 复现需固定reference drift/noise、T、N、DSB rounds、kernel regression/U-Net、forward/backward sampling counts、optimizer、FID implementation与dataset preprocessing。Evidence status: full-text verified theoretical/numerical study; no independent reproduction performed.

sections.title: 阅读指南
paragraphs: 先读 pp.1–3 Figure 1与SB/IPF联系；pp.3–6看DSB算法和theory；pp.7–10读Figures 2–7实验；pp.10–15为discussion、proof sketches和实现细节。
